## About
Asiaworks is a Honda and Acura shop on Sparta Ave in Charlotte, with a second location in Pineville. We use Genuine Honda Parts or parts made by their vendors to save you money, and when it makes sense we'll suggest a good used part as an alternative to new.
We will never recommend a service or repair your car doesn't need. Our technicians are always around to answer your questions, and we stand behind the work we do. One reviewer put it simply: honest and reasonable, unlike dealerships.
Customers know Kevin by name. A driver on a long road trip and another visitor on vacation both wrote that he fit them in and got them back on the road. Another customer called him a master of both customer service and mechanical skill.
We're rated 4.6 from 162 Google reviews. If you drive a Honda or Acura, or another Japanese model, give us a call.

## Services
- Scheduled Vehicle Maintenance: Keeping up with your Honda or Acura's maintenance schedule so problems get handled before they start.
- Diagnostic Testing: Tracking down what's actually wrong before any parts get replaced.
- Engine Repair: Engine work on your Honda or Acura, from a misfire to more involved mechanical repairs.
- Transmission Repair: Diagnosis and repair when your transmission or shifting isn't working right.
- Air Conditioning Repair and Maintenance: Repair and upkeep for your car's air conditioning system.
- Emissions Testing and Repair: Emissions testing, plus the repairs to get your car passing.
- Suspension Services: Service and repair for the parts that keep your ride steady.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Honda and Acura vehicles?
A: Honda and Acura are our focus. For work on other Japanese models, please call us and ask.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: Genuine Honda Parts or parts made by their vendors. When it's appropriate, we'll recommend used parts as an alternative to new.

Q: Will you try to sell me work I don't need?
A: No. We will never recommend a service or repair your vehicle doesn't need.

Q: Do you stand behind your work?
A: Yes. We guarantee all work performed by our technicians.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Fill out the free estimate form and send it to us, and we'll get in touch. You can also call to schedule a consultation or get an estimate.
